scope: External structured synthesis and bounded draft/source consistency check. No new broad literature audit, biological experiment, raw-read analysis or clinical recommendation.

study.title: The role of altered lipid composition and distribution in liver fibrosis revealed by multimodal nonlinear optical microscopy

disposition.oleic_acid: lipid-remodeling comparator; smaller descriptive BUB1B transcript change
disposition.eicosapentaenoic_acid: lipid-remodeling comparator; no deposited EPA RNA arm
disposition.palmitate_d31: injury substrate and isotope tracer, not a beneficial intervention
disposition.summary: An actual BMS-containing treatment arm has higher mean BUB1B RNA than PA alone, near untreated control, alongside measured membrane/lipid improvements. This merits mechanistic follow-up while gene-specific significance, protein/function, causal target attribution and translation remain unqualified.

models_and_roles.role: Disease induction and tissue observations across fibrosis stages; not BMS/OA/EPA treatment efficacy

models_and_roles.model: Human HepaRG cultured cells, GEO genotype WT
models_and_roles.role: Administered PA challenge and compound cotreatments; RNA and membrane/lipid assays

study_arms.role: Untreated HepaRG RNA comparator, 4 h in GEO design
study_arms.vehicle_matching: Final matched DMSO percentage not resolved in focused source check.

study_arms.outcome: Higher membrane order/lower fluidity; BUB1B in the downregulated Figure 6C heatmap and lower descriptive mean.
Membrane/lipid phenotype improvement and selected transcript changes; BUB1B mean modestly above PA, still below control.
Measured membrane/lipid improvement; no EPA BUB1B RNA result is assigned.

study_arms.timing: 24 h BMS with concomitant 4 h PA; detailed order and post-injury rescue timing not inferred.
study_arms.outcome: Lower membrane order/higher fluidity, increased total and unsaturated TG accumulation/unsaturation; higher descriptive BUB1B mean near control.
Figure S16 reports no change in TG accumulation or membrane lipid order; supplies no unstressed BUB1B RNA comparison.

BUB1B_descriptive_expression.units: FPKM in filename/method description; one GEO format sentence says RPKM
BUB1B_descriptive_expression.ratio_definition: Ratio of group means; not paired within-replicate treatment effects.
BUB1B_descriptive_expression.statistical_scope: Descriptive processed FPKM values only; no raw counts reconstructed and no raw-count differential-expression analysis reproduced.

positive_and_null_evidence.level: Measured cellular physical endpoints; not organism or MVA functional rescue.

positive_and_null_evidence.finding: BMS-containing RNA arm has mean BUB1B 2.289570717986207 times PA mean and 1.097599392166232 times control mean.
positive_and_null_evidence.level: Descriptive gene-specific RNA evidence from exact deposited row, all three replicates retained.

positive_and_null_evidence.finding: OA-containing RNA arm has mean BUB1B 1.1838948462015713 times PA mean and 0.567548428782538 times control mean.
positive_and_null_evidence.level: Descriptive smaller RNA shift; no inferential significance claim.

positive_and_null_evidence.finding: BMS alone does not alter reported TG accumulation or membrane order.
positive_and_null_evidence.level: S16 imaging null, not an RNA null.

positive_and_null_evidence.finding: Figure 6C displays BUB1B after PA challenge; Figure 7F/G rescue heatmaps omit BUB1B.
positive_and_null_evidence.level: The deposited row establishes a descriptive signal; displayed rescue heatmaps do not establish BUB1B significance.

target_attribution.established_characterization: FABP4/aP2-directed research inhibitor with weaker reported FABP3/5 affinity
target_attribution.assay: ANS-displacement biochemical Ki, not cellular IC50
target_attribution.FABP1_status: Unknown in the inspected selectivity sources; no claim of absence of binding.
target_attribution.liver_tissue_FABP1: Increased IHC is an expression association, not BMS-FABP1 occupancy or causal dependence of the HepaRG response.
target_attribution.positive_other_model_controls: Original 2007 pharmacology reports FABP4 genetic dependence in macrophage/adipocyte systems; this does not supply FABP1 controls in HepaRG.
target_attribution.cellular_selectivity_at_50_uM: Not established; nominal dose-to-Ki comparisons do not establish intracellular free concentration, occupancy or actual off-target effects.

limitations: WT HepaRG palmitate challenge is not constitutional BUB1B-associated MVA or a Leu737Ter/Asn1002Lys model.
No BUBR1 protein restoration, spindle-checkpoint function, faithful daughter-cell output, segregation correction, muscle output or human MVA benefit is established.
PA+BMS exposure lasts longer than PA and PA+OA; no fully time-matched vehicle/BMS-alone RNA comparison is supplied.
No BMS-alone, OA-alone or EPA RNA group occurs among the twelve deposited libraries.
All three BMS samples retained, including BMS3 separated in source PCA; libraries are not independent human donors.
Processed matrix has expression values rather than raw counts or gene-specific differential-expression statistics.
Methods use an adjusted-significance criterion while S18 labels say P/pvalue without adjustment wording; no BUB1B-specific rescue significance is established.
Figure 7 lipid-panel statistical annotations do not transfer to the BUB1B RNA contrast; omission from a heatmap does not itself prove nonsignificance.
Lower CASP2 expression is not direct measurement of reduced cell death, clonogenic recovery, organ function or corrected chromosome segregation.
FABP1 affinity, cellular target engagement and causal dependence at the tested dose remain unqualified.
Free EPA, oleic acid, dietary mixtures and approved derivative formulations are not interchangeable exposure claims.
The reviewed rescue series supplies no human drug treatment evidence; no new clinical-exposure or regulatory search was conducted.

comparison_to_current_project_nominees.scope: Project comparison supplied by parent; not a new niacin/apitegromab primary reappraisal.
comparison_to_current_project_nominees.BMS_strength: Actual administered-compound association with BUB1B transcript recovery in the reviewed processed data.
comparison_to_current_project_nominees.niacin_distinction: Its BUBR1-restoration bridge depends on different NAD interventions/genetic experiments; separate human muscle NAD engagement and medicine/exposure context do not themselves establish BUBR1 functional rescue.
comparison_to_current_project_nominees.shared_gap: Neither BMS nor niacin establishes relevant-genotype functional rescue.
comparison_to_current_project_nominees.ranking_claim: No superiority claim; mechanistic transcript signal retained without automatically promoting or dismissing it.
comparison_to_current_project_nominees.apitegromab: Provisional compensation nominee, not established MVA benefit.

followup_questions: Does the BUB1B RNA shift persist under matched schedules, matched vehicles and a BMS-alone RNA arm?
Does BUBR1 protein and chromosome-fidelity output improve in affected/corrected BUB1B cells?
Which FABP isoform or other mechanism is engaged, and does an orthogonal target perturbation reproduce or occlude the effect?
Are functional benefit and exposure feasibility sufficient to advance beyond a mechanistic research reserve?
